name: showreel-c3-line-length

voice.text: Your eyes get lost here. Every line is too long. Turns out, short lines are easier. Fix one: narrow the column. Fix two: ten words a line. Fix three: more space between lines. Now it reads like a book.

caption:
Your eyes get lost here. Every line is too long. 📖

1. Narrow the column. The longer the line, the further your eye travels back to find the next one.
2. About ten words a line. Butterick's rule of thumb: 45 to 90 characters, spaces included.
3. More space between lines. Line spacing of 120 to 145% of the text size keeps lines apart.

Save this for your next blog, newsletter or slide. Do you read long lines or skip them?

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a blog page on a laptop on a desk) fills the frame by design
